children: AstraZeneca reported blowout data for its new chronic obstructive pulmonary disease drug, which support sales expectations sharply above current consensus estimates, Citi analysts say in a research note. Full study results from the U.K. pharmaceutical company for its tozorakimab point to potential for a broad use across all populations of COPD patients, the analysts say. Tozorakimab also achieved better data for the subgroup of patients for which Sanofi and Regeneron's Dupixent and GSK's Nucala are approved, they add. As a result, Citi says the data support potential peak sales for tozorakimab of at least its estimate of $7 billion, or roughly double what the current consensus estimate for the drug projects. AstraZeneca shares fall 1.1%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
